correctness.rationale: The eight perfect matchings are completely listed as compositions of five into ones and twos. Edge-positivity counts certify VCdim<=2; a two-edge shattered support proves equality. A deterministic three-query adaptive strategy realizes all eight answer strings and cardinality excludes dimension four. Every interblock edge is a bridge separating even-order components, hence is never used in a perfect matching. This yields exactly 8^m independent concepts, VCdim=2m and Ldim=3m. Standalone enumeration and two-block checks executed successfully.
